title: FoCombatTag
description: Combat tagging with timers, command locks, and safe-zone rules.
body:
![FoCombatTag cover image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/DlXXdjEQ/images/67fc918b350bec76a7b0bfd3e58f45c7e7b412c1.png)

FoCombatTag keeps PvP fights honest by tagging players after real combat, showing a clear countdown, and blocking the common escape routes: logout, commands, safe-zone entry, elytra use, and pearl spam. It is built for servers that want configurable PvP pressure without turning every fight rule into manual staff work.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/ixc43jhOpCk" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## Features
- Tag both players after valid player damage, including projectiles and configurable player-caused explosions.
- Show the remaining combat timer in chat and the actionbar so players know exactly when they are safe.
- Block combat-escape commands while still allowing configured chat, team, reply, and admin command patterns.
- Punish combat logging with optional death, broadcast messages, and console commands.
- Use optional WorldGuard checks to keep tagged players out of PvP-denied regions, with client-side border blocks and configurable pushback.
- Restrict elytra and ender pearl escapes when enabled, with `/elytravault` preserving stored elytras instead of deleting gear.
- Tune common settings from the in-game admin editor, including timer, command allowlist, WorldGuard border, logout handling, elytra rules, pearl cooldowns, and player explosion tagging.

Change Colours of the Combat Wall!

![WorldGuard no-PvP border shown to tagged players](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2212ef109bdd33a0d491c1f683b7bc81eabdfabb_0.webp)

## Dependencies
- `WorldGuard` - Optional; enables PvP-denied region checks, no-PvP border rendering, and region exclusions.
- `PlaceholderAPI` - Optional; enables the placeholders below.

## Commands
- `/focombattagadmin version|reload|editor|tag|untag|status` - Check version, reload, edit settings, manually tag or untag players, and inspect active tags.
- `/elytravault` - Claim elytras stored while elytra restrictions are active.

## Permissions
- `focombattag.admin` - Access to FoCombatTag admin tools.

## Placeholders
Requires PlaceholderAPI.
- `%focombattag_tagged%` - Returns `true` or `false`.
- `%focombattag_remaining%` - Remaining tag time with `s`.
- `%focombattag_remaining_raw%` - Remaining tag time as a number.
